source_substitution.scope: Only actual apron implementation differs; reward city_shared_ground remains the candidate true value in both. This pair does not isolate the separate reward shared-ground config fix.

limits: Functional checks with explicit 70 C start and unchanged90 C/85 C sustained runtime limits. Continuity requires either the clean full dressed suite or strict complete14-theme matrix plus identical original5global assertions; partials never satisfy the gate. External duty released on [Game] ready; external subclasses set and record the explicit render cap, preserving physics ticks and physical acceptance, no performance claim. Route traces use actual physics; initial discovery/placement, god mode, one staged item and scripted combat remain disclosed. The original route probe itself does not consume --runtime-fps. Reward images inherit frozen streaming and disabled ambient combat.

reward_camera_binding.limits: Read-only geometry and ground observations from the actually streamed reward building. The parent fixed-camera preview stages placement and freezes streaming after its checked reload; this is visual evidence, not live traversal or performance evidence.

manifest.limits: Scripted native ground review: player god mode, ambient spawner/encounter beats disabled, controlled real enemies, production attacks/AI/projectiles/HUD, and streaming frozen after the explicit reload. Initial placement is staged at a free cell. Not continuous human play, a balance/performance test or whole-street/roof-depth acceptance.
